no duplicate source_dataset + year + geography + facility + measure + legal_status + sex + sentence_band unless source_table differentiates

ordinary prison comparison must not silently include detention camps, remand homes, juvenile homes or labour camps
distinguish admissions/events from distinct persons admitted and transfers
distinguish daily average from average of periodic counts or unspecified average
derived rate requires positive denominator and documented denominator year/universe
never compare expenditure/labour value cross-jurisdiction without currency/price transformation metadata
production comparative output may use grades A/B only unless analyst explicitly opts into C proxies
